jobDescription:
The AI Adoption Partner is a hands-on AI delivery role where progress is measured in hours and days, not months and years. Our AI is delivered through a defined, sanctioned toolset and inside a clear governance envelope, not through open experimentation with whatever tool is fastest to hand.

Embedded in the business rather than in IT, each AI Adoption Partner finds where AI genuinely moves the needle for their cluster, builds it using internal and external tools and makes sure it is adopted, measured and where it works, spread to the rest of the Group.

The role has three equally weighted objectives: make K3 more efficient; create new or better value for clients; and improve colleagues' working lives by removing repetitive, low-value work. It sits at the intersection of three things that must move together - the Group AI & Data Strategy, the pace the business wants to move at and the obligations (cyber, data and regulatory) K3 already carries as a professional services group.


Why this role is different

This is a live build role inside a Group that has already done the strategic groundwork: an approved AI assistant (Aimee), an approved no-code build environment (Claude Artifacts), a Group AI & Data Strategy and a Cyber Security Strategy already in flight. The AI Adoption Partner does not start from a blank page, they start from a governed platform and a live strategic portfolio, and their job is to turn that into delivered, measured value inside their cluster.

Success is tangible and is tracked centrally: time released, stronger client outcomes, new revenue, reduced risk, and a measurably better colleague experience.


Operating boundaries — what “responsible and fast” means here

Speed in this role comes from working inside a known toolset and a known governance model, not around one. Every AI Adoption Partner works within:

  • Approved toolset only: Aimee and Claude Artifacts. No shadow AI, personal AI accounts, or unapproved frontier-model access.

  • K3's AI Policy and “Golden Rule,” data protection obligations and professional / client confidentiality duties, applied from the first prototype not at go-live.

  • EU AI Act obligations relevant to K3's dual provider / deployer status, including mandatory risk-tiering of any new use case before it touches live client or candidate data.

  • Cost governance: all model usage routed and monitored under the Group's model-routing policy.


Person specification

Essential

  • Proven use of AI and generative AI to deliver measurable business outcomes, ideally including a named conversational AI assistant and a no-code AI build tool (e.g. a Copilot-class assistant, Claude Artifacts/similar).

  • End-to-end delivery experience: problem definition, prototyping, rollout and adoption.

  • Able to understand a business problem quickly and turn it into a working solution at pace, inside a defined toolset.

  • Sound working knowledge of data protection, client confidentiality and responsible AI in a professional or regulated environment; able to apply a risk-tiering process without being told each time.

  • Clear communicator, credible with partners, fee-earners and support teams alike.

  • Curious and adaptable, willing to challenge established ways of working while maintaining trust, professional judgement and toolset discipline.

Desirable

  • Professional services or regulated-advisory experience.

  • Change, product, process-mapping or lean delivery experience.

Job Description

Turn complexity into clarity.

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Making that possible means continually understanding our customers, our business and the opportunities to improve how we work.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you'll turn complex and often loosely defined business questions into clear, actionable insight. You'll use Python, SQL, statistical methods and appropriate machine-learning techniques to understand what's happening, why it's happening and what could happen next.

You'll combine analytical rigour with commercial judgement and strong stakeholder engagement, making sure analysis doesn't stop at an interesting finding. Your work will help people make better decisions, understand opportunities and risks, and take practical action.

This is a role for someone who enjoys creating clarity from ambiguity. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders to understand the question behind the question, explore the data, develop robust analysis and communicate the "so what?" in a way that people can use.

What we're looking for


We're looking for someone who's curious, commercially minded and highly analytical. You'll be equally comfortable working in Python and SQL, discussing an uncertain question with a senior stakeholder and stepping back to explain the "so what?" in clear, straightforward language.

Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys turning ambiguity into clarity and analysis into decisions.

Essential

  • Significant experience as a Data Analyst, Senior Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Insight Analyst or equivalent analytical professional.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to create clarity from ambiguous business questions.
  • Advanced Python skills for data analysis and modelling, together with strong SQL capability.
  • Practical experience applying statistical and data-science techniques to business problems, including several of forecasting, regression, classification, segmentation and propensity modelling.
  • Sound understanding of statistical concepts, model evaluation, uncertainty, bias and the limitations of analytical approaches.
  • Experience working with large or complex datasets and performing data discovery, validation and exploratory analysis.
  • Excellent requirements-gathering, stakeholder-management and project-planning skills.
  • Excellent written communication, with experience producing analytical papers or recommendations for senior audiences.
  • Ability to translate complex analysis into concise conclusions, commercial implications and practical actions.
  • Ability to iterate quickly, prioritise effectively and provide useful initial answers without waiting for perfectly defined requirements.

Desirable

  • Experience with time-series techniques such as ARIMA, exponential smoothing or related forecasting methods.
  • Experience developing customer churn, lifetime value, propensity, anomaly-detection or segmentation models.
  • Experience analysing financial, operational, customer or risk data.
  • Experience using machine-learning techniques beyond traditional statistical analysis.
  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform, Streamlit, and Power BI
  • Experience in financial services or another regulated, data-rich environment.

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000customers trust us to manage more than £121.5billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

Data and insight play an important role in that ambition. By understanding what is happening across our business, our customers and our products, we can make better decisions and continually improve the experience we provide.

We're proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work for the past two years, building on six consecutive years as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For. It's recognition we're proud of and a reflection of the supportive and collaborative culture we strive to create for our people.

What we offer

  • 26 days holiday, increasing with service, plus buy/sell scheme and bank holidays
  • 7% pension with matched contributions
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Share schemes, including free shares and BAYE
  • Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
  • Free onsite gym
  • Enhanced family leave, subject to qualifying criteria
  • Travel and bike loan schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell

  • Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
  • Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
  • Casual dress code
  • Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

At AJ Bell, our people are the heart of our culture. We believe in building strong connections by working together. That's why we offer a hybrid working model, where you'll spend a minimum of 50% of working time per month in the office. For new team members, an initial period will be spent full-time in the office to help you immerse yourself in our business and build valuable relationships with your colleagues.

Inclusion & diversity

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

Agency information

This vacancy is being managed exclusively by our in-house Recruitment team. We are not partnering with recruitment agencies on this opportunity and will only accept applications submitted directly by candidates.

Digital Product and AI Engineer

Salary: £39,000 – £45,000 per annum

At BIMM University, we're more than just an educational institution; we're a vibrant community dedicated to nurturing creativity and empowering students to reach their full potential. With campuses across the UK, Ireland, and Germany, we offer a diverse range of courses in modern music, performing arts, filmmaking and creative technology. Our commitment to excellence in creative arts education sets us apart, providing students with the knowledge, skills, and opportunities they need to succeed in their chosen fields.

About the Role

As Digital Product and AI Engineer, you will play an important role in designing, building and improving digital products and AI-enabled solutions that support students and colleagues across BIMM University. Drawing on a blend of software engineering, product thinking and user-centred design, you'll help turn ideas into practical, scalable solutions that deliver real value across the institution.

Working within Digital, AI and Platform Services, you'll collaborate with colleagues across the University to develop user-facing applications, workflow solutions, integrations and digital experiences that improve how people learn, work and engage with our services. You'll also help shape how AI is applied in a responsible, effective and sustainable way, supporting innovation while ensuring solutions are secure, accessible and fit for purpose.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build and enhance digital products, web applications and workflow solutions that improve the experience of students and colleagues across the University.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements and develop practical, user-centred solutions.
  • Develop and maintain integrations, APIs and automated processes that connect systems and streamline services.
  • Design, develop and support AI-enabled applications and workflows, helping move successful ideas from prototype into production.
  • Collaborate with academic, digital and technology teams to identify opportunities where digital products and AI can enhance learning, teaching and operational processes.
  • Use a range of development approaches and technologies to deliver solutions efficiently, selecting the most appropriate tool for each challenge.
  • Build security, accessibility, privacy and resilience into solutions from the outset, ensuring they meet organisational standards and best practice.
  • Monitor product performance, usage and feedback, using insights to drive continuous improvement and future development.
  • Contribute to software engineering best practice, including testing, documentation, release management and ongoing support.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and AI capabilities, helping identify opportunities that can deliver meaningful benefits for students, colleagues and the wider University.

What You'll Bring:

  • Experience designing, building and supporting digital products, web applications or software solutions within a professional environment.
  • Strong development experience using modern technologies such as C#/.NET, TypeScript / JavaScript or similar platforms and frameworks.
  • Experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication and data flows across multiple systems.
  • Practical experience developing, integrating or prototyping AI-enabled solutions, automations or intelligent workflows.
  • An understanding of software development lifecycles, including discovery, testing, deployment, support and continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge of secure software development, accessibility, data protection and user-focused design principles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate user needs into effective technical solutions.
  • Experience using product insights, service data and user feedback to inform development decisions and improve outcomes.
  • The ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences and build positive working relationships across teams.

The postholder can be based within a commutable distance of one of BIMM University’s seven UK campuses (Brighton, London, Essex, Bristol, Birmingham, Manchester or Leeds).

We encourage early applications, as we may close the advert ahead of the stated deadline if we receive a high volume of interest.

Why BIMM University

We are a values-led organisation, meaning our core values underpin all that we do:

Believe in Everyone, Challenge the Norm, Grow Together, Do The Right Thing, Own It.

In addition to joining a committed and dedicated team, you will have access to:

  • 25 days holiday per year (FTE)
  • SMART pension
  • A comprehensive benefits package

We continually strive to create a culture of inclusivity so that we truly represent our diverse communities. We particularly welcome applications from people of colour who are underrepresented in our organisation.

We are committed to promoting the safety and welfare of our students therefore, all successful applicants are required to complete a basic DBS disclosure. Depending on the role, you may be required to complete an enhanced check / enhanced check with barred list if required by statute and internal policy.

How To Apply

Data Scientist

Location: Manchester, Exchange Quays
Working pattern: Hybrid- 2 days a week on site
Department: Technology
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join an ambitious technology business in Manchester, working at the intersection of data science, AI, behavioural insights and technology.

You'll join the Insight Services team, working alongside experienced Data Scientists to develop the data pipelines, analytical models and AI products that sit behind a growing technology platform.

This is a hands-on role combining data science, R development and data engineering in AWS. You'll have the opportunity to work across the full data lifecycle, from collecting and transforming data through to building models, deploying solutions and supporting them in production.

Around 80% of your time will be focused on AI product development, data engineering and product enhancement, with the remaining 20% focused on Level 3 technical support.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that collect, clean and transform customer and internal data

  • Develop data analysis and statistical models using R

  • Build, test and maintain machine learning and predictive models

  • Develop and deploy R-based applications and data workflows within AWS

  • Work with structured and unstructured data to identify trends, patterns and insights

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines and data workflows

  • Work with AWS services including S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS, Glue and CloudWatch

  • Monitor data quality, pipeline performance and production issues

  • Design and maintain data models and database schemas

  • Write efficient SQL queries and work with relational databases

  • Use Git, testing and version control to produce reliable and maintainable code

  • Create data visualisations and communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Translate business challenges into analytical questions and evidence-based solutions

  • Support behavioural and risk segmentation, research and cost analysis

  • Provide Level 3 technical support, investigating and resolving complex application and data issues

  • Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation and continuous improvement

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone with around 1-2 years of commercial experience who has exposure to both the analytical and engineering sides of data.

You'll need:

  • 1+ years' commercial experience in data analysis or data science

  • 1+ years' commercial experience developing in R using RStudio / Posit

  • Strong working knowledge of statistics and machine learning

  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines

  • Practical experience working with AWS, ideally including S3 and a managed database service such as RDS

  • Strong SQL skills

  • Experience working with a relational database such as MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server

  • Experience writing reusable, tested code

  • Experience using Git and version control

R experience is mandatory for this role.

Desirable experience

It would be beneficial if you also have experience with:

  • MySQL

  • Python

  • Docker and containerisation

  • CI/CD pipelines

  • Terraform or CloudFormation

  • Airflow, AWS Step Functions or other workflow orchestration tools

  • Building APIs or packaging models in R, such as plumber or R packages

  • SaaS or software product environments

  • Customer-facing or application support

  • Social Housing data, research or analytics

About you

You'll be analytical, curious and comfortable getting hands-on with data and code.

You'll enjoy solving problems, understanding how data can improve decision-making and learning new technologies. You'll also be comfortable explaining technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and working collaboratively with more experienced members of the team.

We're particularly interested in people who demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Good mathematical and statistical ability

  • Excellent attention to detail

  • A passion for data science, software development and well-engineered data systems

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • A willingness to learn and take feedback

  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks

A degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or another technical discipline would be beneficial, although equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.

Why join?

You'll be joining a growing technology business where data science and AI are central to the products being developed.

The role offers the chance to work across R, machine learning, AWS, data engineering and AI, while learning directly from experienced Data Scientists and contributing to products used to solve real-world challenges across sectors including Social Housing, Local Government and Healthcare.

If you're an early-career Data Scientist who wants to build strong commercial experience across both data science and data engineering, this is an opportunity to develop a broad and highly valuable technical skillset.

Help build and scale practical AI solutions that solve real business problems
We're working with an organisation that is investing heavily in AI and automation and is looking for an AI Engineer to join a growing team. This is an opportunity to work on projects that move beyond experimentation, taking AI solutions from proof of concept into production and delivering measurable business impact.

This role would suit someone with a software engineering background who has started building experience with AI technologies and wants to accelerate their development within a supportive engineering environment.

The Role
As an AI Engineer, you'll work across the full solution lifecycle, helping to design, build and deploy AI-powered applications whilst ensuring the underlying integrations, data and processes are robust and scalable.
You'll be involved in:

  • Building AI-enabled solutions such as conversational assistants, workflow automation and intelligent document processing
  • Developing applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent-based approaches
  • Taking solutions from prototype through to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement
  • Building and maintaining APIs, integrations and data pipelines that support AI applications
  • Working closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions
  • Supporting user testing, rollout and adoption of new AI capabilities
  • Contributing to engineering standards, testing, documentation and CI/CD practices

What We're Looking For
Essential Experience

  • Experience in software engineering, application development, APIs, integrations or data pipelines
  • Strong programming skills in Python or a similar language
  • Exposure to Large Language Models, prompting, model APIs or AI applications through commercial work, study or personal projects
  • Experience working with SQL and real-world data
  • Experience deploying solutions into cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrable ability to learn new technologies quickly

Desirable Experience

  • Agentic AI or AI agent frameworks
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Workflow automation platforms
  • AI evaluation, monitoring or observability
  • Experience working within regulated environments
  • Agile delivery experience

About YouThis organisation is placing particular emphasis on mindset and potential.

You'll likely be:

  • Curious and passionate about learning new technologies
  • Pragmatic and focused on delivering value rather than chasing perfection
  • Interested in understanding business problems as well as technical challenges
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities
  • Open to feedback and continuous improvement
  • Honest about the opportunities and limitations of AI
  • Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions

If you're excited by the prospect of helping build practical AI solutions whilst developing your own expertise in a rapidly evolving field, we'd love to hear from you.

What if housing and social care worked together around the person, rather than residents having to navigate the boundaries between different organisations?

* Planning and prioritising analytical work across multiple initiatives and stakeholders

* Advanced SQL skills and strong Python capability

* Understanding of product analytics and digital tracking platforms such as Google Analytics or similar tools

* Experience working within cross-functional product teams

* Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

* Experience influencing decision-makers through evidence-based recommendations

* Passion for mentoring colleagues and driving analytics best practice

* Ongoing learning, development, and career progression opportunities
